properties.name: Colosseum
properties.description: Massive amphitheater where gladiatorial combats honored Mars and other war gods. Could seat 50,000 spectators.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, Rome's most iconic landmark

properties.name: Pantheon — Temple of All Gods
properties.description: Temple dedicated to all Roman gods, rebuilt by Hadrian. Its unreinforced concrete dome remains the world's largest after nearly 2,000 years.
properties.modernStatus: Active church, UNESCO World Heritage Site

properties.name: Pompeii
properties.description: Roman city frozen in time by Vesuvius's eruption in 79 CE. Temples to Jupiter, Apollo, Isis, and Venus preserved exactly as they were.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, ongoing excavation
